summary: Iteration 5 — DutyConnect M3b frontend E2E (viewport 390x844, Expo web preview, user delivered+t1@resend.dev). All requested FE flows pass end-to-end. Created 2 shifts via /shift-form FAB (completed Bed Watch 15 Oct 08:00-16:00 @ £20/h → estimated £160.00; booked Bed Watch 16 Oct 09:00-14:00 @ £22/h → projected £110.00). Recorded a partial payment of £80 via actions-sheet → PaymentsPanel → payment-add-button → payment-save-button; payments-status became 'Partially paid', payments-received £80.00, payments-outstanding £80.00. Earnings screen (testID earnings-screen) renders segmented week/month/year — earnings-period-label updates ('October 2026' / '2026' / '28 Sept – 4 Oct 2026'), earnings-prev + earnings-next cycle labels symmetrically, earnings-estimated £160.00, earnings-received £80.00, earnings-outstanding £80.00, earnings-completed 1, earnings-hours 8.00, earnings-booked '1 booked · £110.00 projected'; earnings-duty-bed_watch row present with correct per-duty totals. Export: earnings-export-button opens export-sheet (period 'October 2026 · 2 shifts'); export-csv-button → export-privacy-warning (with export-confirm-button + export-back-button) → confirm fires a web download 'DutyConnect-report-2026-10-01-to-2026-10-31.csv' (page.expect_download captured it); export-pdf-button also shows the same privacy warning; export-back-button and export-close-button both reset the sheet. Account → account-export-row opens the same sheet labelled 'All records · 2 shifts' as required. Matching-totals contract VERIFIED on same shift set: Home 'This month' card (home-stat-estimated £160.00, home-stat-outstanding £80.00, home-stat-hours 8.00, home-stat-completed 1) == Earnings month view == History shifts-list-summary ('1 shifts · 1 completed · 8h · est. £160.00 · received £80.00') — all three surfaces agree, confirming summarise() is the single source of truth. Recently Deleted: shift-action-delete opens shift-delete-confirm whose copy explicitly mentions 'Recently Deleted', '90 days', 'all its payments', and 'restored from Account' (verbatim); shift-delete-confirm-button removes the shift from calendar/list and drops Earnings month to 0/£0.00/£0.00/0.00 immediately. Account → account-deleted-row → recently-deleted-screen renders deleted-item-<id> with 'Deleted 12/10/2026 · 90 days left · 1 payment (£80.00) kept' metadata, confirming retention days-left + kept payments. deleted-restore-<id> restores the shift + its payment; Earnings and Home totals return to £160.00/£80.00/£80.00/8.00/1 exactly. Regression: shifts-screen calendar + List toggles (Month/Week/List), shifts-list-tab-upcoming/history, SyncBadge ('Synced'), home-next-shift-card, home-quick-add-shift still work. Provisional-clash UI (shift-card-provisional, home/earnings-provisional-banner, payment-clash-panel, payment-clash-keep-*) was NOT exercised this iteration — simulating it needs two-device /api/shifts/sync pushes which the request flagged as optional; the matching backend contract is covered in /app/backend/tests/test_m3b_safeguards.py (not re-run per request). No React Native red screens, no new deprecated-package usage (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch absent from package.json). Carryover console warnings only: shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents (both pre-existing from iteration 1, benign).

issues: On narrow (390x844) web, Playwright reports buttons inside the modal as 'outside the viewport' when the sheet is tall; real touch works fine but automation needs dispatch_event('click') or scroll_into_view. Not a user-facing bug, just a web-automation note — the modal content is clipped only when the keyboard would be summoned on a very short screen. Consider wrapping the sheet body in a ScrollView already present elsewhere to reduce clipping.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — persists across the shell. No file pinpointed by RN warning stack; likely in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx or ./shift-card.tsx shadow style blocks.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — persists; likely from a third-party gesture wrapper (react-native-reanimated or react-native-screens).

Nice-to-have: migrate residual shadow* → boxShadow and prop pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence the two carryover console warnings (iteration 1 carryover).

Optional follow-up (not blocking): a dedicated multi-device-clash E2E — publish a POST /api/shifts/sync payload with two active payments sharing origin_id, then pull-to-refresh and assert shift-card-provisional-<id>, home-provisional-banner, earnings-provisional-banner, payment-clash-panel and payment-clash-keep-<paymentId> resolving the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: stats.ts:14 summarise() is correctly used by Home (/(tabs)/index.tsx:140 home-month-summary-card), Earnings (/(tabs)/earnings.tsx:43), History (/components/shift-list-view.tsx:95 shifts-list-summary) AND report.ts:43 — single source of truth, which the matching-totals test confirmed numerically.

stats.ts:28 'outstanding' uses Math.max(s.outstanding ?? 0, 0) so an overpaid shift does NOT reduce dashboard outstanding — matches payments-panel which labels negative outstanding as 'Overpaid'. Good consistency.
stats.ts:19 pence arithmetic (Math.round(v*100)) prevents float drift when summing many partial payments; mirrors backend payment_fields integer-pence approach.

report.ts:24 cell() correctly neutralises CSV-injection (=,+,-,@,TAB,CR prefixes). HEAD/rowValues/Totals block structure matches what the backend emits — exported CSV filename seen in download: 'DutyConnect-report-2026-10-01-to-2026-10-31.csv'.
export-sheet.tsx:52 Two-step confirm (format pick → privacy warning → confirm) correctly surfaces the privacy warning before any share/download — not shortcircuited anywhere.
shift-actions-sheet.tsx:117 Delete-confirm copy explicitly mentions 'Recently Deleted', '90 days' and restore-from-Account — matches the user-facing wording required for M3b safeguards.

recently-deleted.tsx:40 days-left formula Math.max(0, 90 - floor((Date.now()-deletedTime)/86_400_000)) matches server retention policy; '90 days left · 1 payment (£80.00) kept' rendered correctly for a just-deleted shift.
provider.tsx (deletedTime/DELETED_RETENTION_DAYS/restore()) wires the trash + restore cleanly; restore round-trip verified empirically (Home/Earnings returned to pre-delete values byte-for-byte).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on everything in-scope for this iteration — login, shift CRUD, payment record, Earnings surfaces & nav, Export CSV+PDF privacy flow + CSV download, Account 'All records' export, matching totals across Home/Earnings/History, Recently-Deleted delete→list→restore, basic regression (calendar/list/upcoming/sync badge). seed_data_creation: Two shifts persisted to delivered+t1@resend.dev account at end of run: completed Bed Watch 15 Oct 08:00-16:00 @ £20/h with one £80 payment (shift id f32e6e72-cf90-4026-8358-198f6c7ba7c5), and booked Bed Watch 16 Oct 09:00-14:00 @ £22/h. Main agent / next tester may delete or keep — totals are self-consistent and useful for a quick manual smoke.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Current environment date is October 2026 (not Jan 2026 as the prompt header says) — the backend/front use the system clock, so when exercising month-based periods pick dates in the current server month. Tab bar testIDs are tab-home / tab-shifts / tab-earnings / tab-account (set via Tabs.Screen tabBarButtonTestID in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx) — these are stable and reachable from any tab screen, but are HIDDEN when a stack-route like /recently-deleted or /shift-form is on top; use the StackHeader back button first (or router.back()). ExportSheet and ShiftActionsSheet are RN Modals; on web their inner buttons sometimes fall outside Playwright's 'visible viewport' heuristic — the reliable workaround is page.locator(sel).dispatch_event('click') (used throughout this run). PickerField in web is a masked TextField ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'HH:MM') with testID equal to the one passed in — use page.fill('') then page.type() to overwrite the placeholder cleanly. Shift status is a Segmented with testPrefix 'shift-status' → data-testid 'shift-status-completed' etc. The payment date field for a new payment defaults to today so no need to touch it for a smoke flow. For the provisional-clash E2E follow-up, see payments-panel.tsx:86 clashGroups(shift.payments) and provider.resolvePaymentClash(shiftId, paymentId) — the UI expects two active payments with the same origin_id on the same shift.
rca_of_issue: No defects identified. M3b scope — S1 provisional clash (UI wiring verified by code review; runtime path not exercised), S2 Recently Deleted (fully verified: 90-day copy, days-left meta, kept-payments meta, restore round-trip), F4 Earnings dashboard (fully verified across all testIDs and period nav), F5 CSV/PDF export with privacy warning & All-records entry point from Account (fully verified) — behave exactly as the spec requires, and the single-source-of-truth summarise()/periodRange() implementation keeps Home, Earnings and History numerically identical for the same shift set.
